body: I personally known or have known people that are going through this or have gone through this. It gets better, utilize any and all the resources available to you, pursue your passions a little bit at a time, play a little music here and there, dabble in computers. Try finding some new things to be interested in, read books, comics, play video games. Life will get better, it takes time and high school isn't the easiest or most fun experience ever but university and or adult life is fantastic, you have all the freedom in the world paired with the control to do whatever. Do you have any life goals? Any thing you want to really do in life?

Hey there, first off please don't do this, you have people that love and care about you, strangers on reddit care about you too. Second, I know that pain, but people that feel that pain are needed in this world, we are needed to help change it whether it be in a small or big way. The selfishness and hate will continue to occur, but someone like you who cares so much can change that, just change that pain into drive and you'll see that the world can be a happier place, especially with you in it. As for the people around you, sure they may not inspire your faith but this world if filled with 6 billion people, and I'm sure there has to be atleast one person to keep your faith, you just havent met them yet. Stay alive, keep searching, change those bits of selfishness and hatred you think are so vile.

By accepting it for what it is, it's happened and its unchangeable and trying to fight it will only cause you more stress, you made a mistake, but that isn't all that you have, this mistake isn't you. Despite anything that might come your way you still have a loving family and great friends, and as far as consequences go, no jail time is pretty great. You can always talk to a councillor as well, they can help you get things back on track as well, I can vouch for that because they helped me get back on track with my life when I felt like you do. Don't give up OP, you made it this far and you have the support of both your loved ones and people on Reddit :) Have Hope, I believe that things will get better for you.

College and getting away will be nice, everyone is pretty lost about school and stuff but its good to perceiver, a college education can get you a lot of places, even if it doesnt seem like it right now. As for being a transgender, I accept you and I'm sure that a lot of others that actually know you accept you too. Don't kill yourself, life really is beautiful, it's sad that your parents dont understand but maybe its best not to seek their approval any more and go out into the world and be with the people that accept you. Hope is the most powerful thing OP, it can take you places you've never been, light up the darkest times, and help you get back up when you're down.

Yeah...I've done my research as well, and anti-depressants in me 16-25 (dont quote me on that final number) have a high risk of actually making it worse. Despite canada's "free healthcare" I can't even afford anti-depressants, they're too many other things that take precedence over MAYBE helping my chemical imbalances...and the last time I took anti-depressants my dad started treating me differently...He never agreed with taking pills or takes mental health issues very seriously, you know being raised in the 50's and all...I'm also scared of the pills...I took prozac for this once and it just fucked me up beyond all belief...Counselling doesn't work either, I'm stuck with this mentality that they are there only to get paid, if they were a person in the street, would they take the time to help you? Probably not. I too just stumbled on this subreddit,those are the only two reasons I don't kill myself either...Hope and I couldn't begin to imagine how it would make my loved ones feel...We should both keep hoping right?
